name: Suning Universal Co.,Ltd
summary: Suning Universal Co.,Ltd operates as a real estate development company in China. It also engages in the project investment business; commercial retail; culture business; hotel catering; yacht rental; financial services; health investment; as well as pledging and financial leasing. In addition, the company engages in commercial operations; film and television; cultural creativity; education investment; cartoon business; and cosmetic medicine. Suning Universal Co.,Ltd was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Nanjing, China.
